svg.aria-label: TinyTorch: A deep learning framework from scratch in C++20: strided tensors with broadcasting and zero-copy views, reverse-mode autodiff, NN layers and SGD/Adam, with gradients checked against finite differences. Next: an arena allocator and a cache-blocked AVX2/FMA matmul kernel benchmarked against OpenBLAS.
